basic_profile.bio: A passionate film enthusiast and aspiring screenwriter based in Paris, France. I have a deep love for the film industry and dream of working in Hollywood. I frequently travel between France and the United States, attending film festivals and networking events. My interests include acting, screenwriting, and exploring the latest in film technology. I'm currently working as a freelance writer for a film magazine. In a committed relationship and enjoy spending my evenings watching classic films or attending local theatre productions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Film Studies from a French university and have spent several years self-teaching screenwriting techniques through online courses and workshops. I keep up with industry trends by following industry news, podcasts, and attending film forums.
